resume.name: Farah Qureshi
achievements: Introduced a payroll checklist that halved correction requests.
resume.statement: I moved cities to start again. I am organised, quick, and I learn every system I am given.

aadhaar.address.note: The ID card still shows a Lucknow address. Her resume says Mumbai.

passport.address.note: The passport also carries the old Lucknow address.

passport.name.note: The passport reads "Farha", not "Farah". One transposed letter.

passport.expiry.note: This passport expired in March 2026. It is not valid identification today.

employment.designation.note: Matches the resume word for word. But look closely: the designation line is set in a slightly different typeface from the rest of the letter, and the baseline sits two millimetres low.

employment.left.note: Letter says August 2025, matching the resume. The date line uses the same mismatched typeface.

c04_relocation.text: Resume states she relocated from Lucknow to Mumbai in 2025.

c04_title_jump.text: Moved from Accounts Assistant to "Senior Accounts Executive" with no intermediate title.

c04_ca_partial.text: Lists CA Intermediate Group I only (partial qualification), stated honestly.

c04_address_mismatch.text: CONTRADICTION: ID card address is Lucknow; resume address is Mumbai.

c04_passport_correction.text: Passport office portal: renewal application filed Feb 2026 with a name-spelling correction ("Farha" → "Farah"). Status: in process.

c04_relocation_confirm.text: Her first employer confirms she moved to Mumbai in 2025; address change is genuine.

c04_letter_font.text: CONTRADICTION: the experience letter's designation and date lines are in a different typeface from the rest of the letter.

c04_meridian_truth.text: Meridian HR: she was an Accounts Assistant, never Senior Accounts Executive, and she left in February 2023 — not August 2025.

c04_logo.text: Meridian rebranded in 2022; the letter carries the old logo but is dated 2025.

c04_awadh_praise.text: Awadh Traders' owner: "Fast, honest with money, learned everything in a month."

c04_volunteer.text: Social media shows her volunteering at a community kitchen. Irrelevant to the job.

search.title: Meridian unveils new brand identity (2022)
search.snippet: From 1 July 2022 all Meridian correspondence uses our new logo and letterhead...
search.body: Meridian Finserv announces its new brand identity. From 1 July 2022 all official correspondence, including HR letters, carries the new logo and letterhead. Old stationery has been withdrawn.

search.body: A public post of volunteers serving food at a community kitchen in Andheri. Nothing in it relates to her employment history.
